record.prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Asset type: scientific explorer hypothetical local terrain card, wide 16:9. Primary request: independently invent a cautious near-ground scene on Titania, Uranus moon, with grey ice-rich-looking regolith, scattered angular blocks, low crater rims and a distant modest fault scarp cutting an old cratered plain. This is a new imagined landscape, not a reconstruction of a named Voyager site or any existing Moon, Mars or other body map. Black airless sky with no astronomical disk, stars, haze or clouds. Low-angle artistic illumination, restrained greys with subtle brown dust; material fractions, chemistry, relief and lighting are unmeasured artistic choices. No exposed liquid, ocean, plume, cryovolcanic eruption, life, people, buildings or landing craft. Composition: foreground blocks and shallow depression, distant scarp below horizon, detailed sober photographic illustration. Text verbatim: large clear top-left "TITANIA · IMAGINED"; bottom-left "Invented terrain · no registered site". No other labels, scale bars or coordinates. Do not imitate observed geography or use an analog skin.
